title: DockForgeAI — resource-aware molecular docking, virtual screening and hit-prioritization platform

author.name: Pratik-2002-ux
author.field: Computational structural biology / structure-based drug discovery (cheminformatics)

provenance.origin: github.com/Pratik-2002-ux/DockForgeAI at e87dcd3b833e, github (github: topic:streamlit topic:computational-biology archived:false (page 2))

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Reviewing a validated HIV-1 protease (1HSG/MK1) redocking case — RMSD against the crystal pose, catalytic Asp25 contacts, a small screening shortlist and its consensus ranking — and packaging the evidence as offline reports and data files. A separate machine-learning activity-classifier benchmark (XAI pages) sits alongside it and does not feed the consensus ranking. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
